brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE Japanese basketball editorial website thumbnail, landscape 1600 x 900 pixels, approximately 16:9, opaque PNG.
Create a new finished thumbnail. Use the previously viewed black/lime approved thumbnail only as a STYLE REFERENCE (heavy Japanese type, hand ink, brush energy, simple editorial composition). Use the previously viewed official Erik McCree portrait only as a LIKENESS REFERENCE. These are reference images, not edit targets; do not paste either reference or recreate any previous article's names/scores.

Subject: ONE real professional basketball player, Erik McCree (エリック・マクリー) of Gifu Swoops, shown in an illustrative powerful forward drive, torso leaning left into the motion, basketball controlled low in his right hand, left arm naturally bent away from the lettering, face clearly visible in three-quarter view. This is an imagined generic basketball movement, never a recreation of an actual game. His name MUST NOT appear anywhere. Identity from the official portrait: tall broad muscular build, medium-dark brown skin, broad nose, full lips, alert brown eyes with strong brow, short dense textured black afro with a slightly irregular rounded silhouette, thick full black beard connected to moustache, squared rounded jaw under beard, arm tattoos rendered as loose ink details. Preserve these distinctive features. Plain ivory basketball jersey with dark trims and plain shorts; no numbers, team or league logos, sponsor marks, branding, or writing on clothing or ball. No other people.

Style: emphatically DRAWN editorial sports illustration, expressive thick black ink contours and ivory/gray hatch strokes, not photorealistic, no pasted official photo, no 3D render. Background near black #151A18, vivid lime #CCF43B diagonal dry-brush strokes behind the player, ivory headline, orange basketball as one small warm accent. High contrast, dramatic and clean.

Composition: text takes the LEFT 55%, player takes the RIGHT 45%, dynamic low dribble angle rather than overhead shooting pose. Head, face, both hands and entire ball fully inside the frame. Deliberate crop of legs around upper thigh is allowed. Nothing crosses or obscures lettering. Keep all text at least 55 pixels from outer edges, with a clear dark bottom strip for notes. Strong spacing and hierarchy, no crowded extra marks.

Text (render exactly, and render NO other text):
Top small label: "B.ONE"
Large lime date: "11/27"
Largest heavy ivory headline: "試合予定"
Medium line: "19:05 開始予定"
Two clear smaller matchup lines:
"横浜EX × 岐阜"
"福岡 × 越谷"
Bottom left, readable qualifier: "11/27 00:46時点・試合前"
Bottom strip, clearly readable: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Immediately adjacent in same strip: "イメージ"

Article context for factual restraint only: frozen manuscript says both listed games are scheduled for 19:05 on 2026-11-27 and still pregame as of 00:46 JST. Results, EFF and best-five are unconfirmed. Do not write results, scores, player statistics, player participation, player names, MVP claims, rankings, or best-five claims. The player is randomly selected from a team in the manuscript solely to illustrate the sport.
Ensure Japanese glyphs and numbers are crisp, correctly spelled, and fully visible. Human anatomy should be plausible, exactly two arms/hands, natural five-finger hand forms, no fused fingers. Produce ONLY one final designed thumbnail.

SINGLE PERMITTED CORRECTION
Edit the generated basketball thumbnail. This is the single permitted revision.
Edit target: the supplied finished black/lime thumbnail. Supporting identity reference: official Erik McCree portrait supplied as the second image, only to match the haircut; do not paste the photograph.
Make ONE targeted correction to the HAIR AND ITS TOP CLEARANCE ONLY: change the current overly tall separated curls into Erik McCree's compact, short, dense, natural black afro seen in his official reference. Lower the highest silhouette of the hair so there is at least 40 pixels of visible background between the entire head/hair and the top border. Keep his facial features, thick beard, head position, eyes, expression, body pose, tattoos, hands, ball, jersey, and all the rest of the image unchanged. The head must be fully inside the frame with a clear top margin. Fill the newly vacated area with the existing lime/black brush background coherently.
Preserve the drawn ink illustration style, all colors, canvas proportions and resolution. Preserve EVERY Japanese glyph, number and the text layout EXACTLY. Keep all text:
B.ONE
11/27
試合予定
19:05 開始予定
横浜EX × 岐阜
福岡 × 越谷
11/27 00:46時点・試合前
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ
Do not add names, scores, logos, or any new elements. Return only one corrected PNG at the same approximately 16:9 resolution, at least 1000 pixels wide.
